env_vars.TREASURY_MODEL_API_KEY: Groq key; when empty, every AI path falls back to deterministic prose

global_safety_rails: Never predict, forecast, or comment on where FX rates will move.
Never invent counterparties — the id must be in the whitelist passed in the input.
Never invent monetary amounts — must be present in the input.
Use display strings verbatim ('€10m', '$21m') — never raw digit strings ('21,000,000 USD').
Every AI path has a deterministic fallback that runs on no-key, timeout, or validation failure.
The LLM never books a deal. It writes prose, ranks candidates, picks from whitelists.

paths.purpose: Rank the 3 planner candidates and write the AI Quick Summary + per-candidate labels.

shape_out.labels: map of candidate.kind → one-sentence trade-off label

validators: kind matches a real candidate in the plan
paths.fallback: deterministic 4-bullet summary picking the highest expected-interest candidate

paths.purpose: Cross-currency policy-gap briefing + a recommended action per currency + watch callouts.

shape_out.briefing: paragraph ranking currencies by gap-to-target severity
shape_out.recommendations: one per currency with a gap; {currency, amount_minor, tenor_months, counterparty_id, reason}

validators: amount_minor in suggested_amounts for that currency
paths.fallback: deterministic priority-first briefing + a recommendation per gapped currency picking the highest-rated FX-approved counterparty with headroom

paths.purpose: Contextual governance observations for the Initiate Hedge modal — concentration, headroom, ladder, policy movement.
inputs_deterministic: counterparty share of the FX book after the trade
paths.llm_role: rewrite deterministic bullets in tighter English, preserving every number and name
explicitly_removed: cost-of-carry / forward-vs-spot commentary (removed 2026-09-11 to keep this pure governance narration)
validators: bullet count must match the deterministic input

paths.purpose: Read seeded NewsItems, classify materiality, surface per-counterparty severity + suggested action.
Parse a pasted SWIFT-like confirmation into a structured proposal for matching.

audit_log.planned_table: ai_run { id, tenant_id, endpoint, prompt_json, response_json, model, tokens, created_by_user_id, created_at }
